from lfx.base.data.utils import IMG_FILE_TYPES, TEXT_FILE_TYPES
from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput
from lfx.io import (
    DropdownInput,
    FileInput,
    MessageTextInput,
    MultilineInput,
    Output,
)
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)


class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # Ensure files is a list and filter out empty/None values
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        # Filter out None/empty values
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        session_id = self.session_id or self.graph.session_id or ""
        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=session_id,
            context_id=self.context_id,
            files=files,
        )
        if session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message

from collections.abc import Generator
from typing import Any

import orjson
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder

from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.helpers.data import safe_convert
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput, DropdownInput, HandleInput, MessageTextInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data
from lfx.schema.dataframe import DataFrame
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.schema.properties import Source
from lfx.template.field.base import Output
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)


class ChatOutput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Output"
    description = "Display a chat message in the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Inputs",
            info="Message to be passed as output.",
            input_types=["Data", "JSON", "DataFrame", "Table", "Message"],
            required=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
            advanced=True,
            info="Type of sender.",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="data_template",
            display_name="Data Template",
            value="{text}",
            advanced=True,
            info="Template to convert Data to Text. If left empty, it will be dynamically set to the Data's text key.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="clean_data",
            display_name="Basic Clean Data",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
            info="Whether to clean data before converting to string.",
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Output Message",
            name="message",
            method="message_response",
        ),
    ]

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, _, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()

        # Create or use existing Message object
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message) and not self.is_connected_to_chat_input():
            message = self.input_value
            # Update message properties
            message.text = text
            # Preserve existing session_id from the incoming message if it exists
            existing_session_id = message.session_id
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)
            existing_session_id = None

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        # Preserve session_id from incoming message, or use component/graph session_id
        message.session_id = (
            self.session_id or existing_session_id or (self.graph.session_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None) or ""
        )
        message.context_id = self.context_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)

        # Store message if needed
        if message.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        # Set accumulated token usage from all upstream LLM vertices.
        # This must happen AFTER send_message() because streaming captures
        # usage from chunks and would overwrite accumulated totals.
        if hasattr(self, "_vertex") and self._vertex is not None:
            accumulated_usage = self._vertex._accumulate_upstream_token_usage()  # noqa: SLF001
            if accumulated_usage:
                message.properties.usage = accumulated_usage
                if self.should_store_message and message.get_id():
                    message = await self._update_stored_message(message)
                    await self._send_message_event(message, id_=message.get_id())

        self.status = message
        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value)

import csv
import json
import os
import re

from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import MessageTextInput, Output
from langflow.schema import Message


class MiraMilestoneSourceProcessor(Component):
    display_name = "Mira Milestone Source Processor"
    description = "Reads and validates the project timeline CSV."
    icon = "calendar"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="csv_path",
            display_name="CSV File Path",
            value=r"data/project_timeline.csv",
            required=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="user_request",
            display_name="User Request",
            required=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            name="milestone_context",
            display_name="Milestone Context",
            method="process_timeline",
        )
    ]

    def process_timeline(self) -> Message:
        path = str(self.csv_path or "").strip().strip('"')
        request = str(self.user_request or "").strip()

        context = {
            "project_name": "AI Adoption Project at ABCDE Ltd.",
            "data_status": "SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "source_file": os.path.basename(path),
            "source_type": "project_timeline_csv",
            "snapshot_date": "NOT_PROVIDED",
            "timeline_type": "PLANNED_ONLY",
            "project_start_date": None,
            "current_project_week": None,
            "actual_completion_data_available": False,
            "explicit_dependencies_available": False,
            "user_request": request,
            "total_phases": 0,
            "planned_project_duration_weeks": None,
            "scope_type": "project",
            "requested_phase": None,
            "selected_phases": [],
            "data_quality_notes": [],
        }

        if not os.path.isfile(path):
            context["data_quality_notes"].append(
                "Project timeline CSV not found at configured path."
            )
            return Message(text=json.dumps(context, indent=2))

        required_columns = [
            "phase",
            "phase_name",
            "start_week",
            "end_week",
            "key_activities",
            "milestones_deliverables",
        ]

        try:
            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as file:
                reader = csv.DictReader(file)
                headers = reader.fieldnames or []

                missing = [
                    col for col in required_columns
                    if col not in headers
                ]
                if missing:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Missing required columns: " + ", ".join(missing)
                    )

                phases = []
                seen_phase_numbers = set()

                for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
                    if not any(str(v or "").strip() for v in row.values()):
                        continue

                    phase_number = int(row["phase"])
                    start_week = int(row["start_week"])
                    end_week = int(row["end_week"])

                    if phase_number in seen_phase_numbers:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Duplicate phase number: {phase_number}"
                        )

                    if start_week < 1 or end_week < start_week:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Invalid week range at CSV row {row_number}"
                        )

                    seen_phase_numbers.add(phase_number)

                    activities = [
                        item.strip()
                        for item in (row["key_activities"] or "").split(";")
                        if item.strip()
                    ]

                    deliverables = [
                        item.strip()
                        for item in (
                            row["milestones_deliverables"] or ""
                        ).split(";")
                        if item.strip()
                    ]

                    phases.append({
                        "phase": phase_number,
                        "phase_name": (
                            row["phase_name"] or ""
                        ).strip(),
                        "start_week": start_week,
                        "end_week": end_week,
                        "duration_weeks": end_week - start_week + 1,
                        "key_activities": activities,
                        "milestones_deliverables": deliverables,
                        "actual_status": "NOT_PROVIDED",
                        "actual_completion_date": None,
                        "dependencies": "NOT_PROVIDED",
                    })

            if not phases:
                raise ValueError("Timeline CSV contains no phases.")

            phases.sort(key=lambda item: item["phase"])

            match = re.search(
                r"\bphase\s*(?:number\s*)?(\d+)\b",
                request,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            requested_phase = int(match.group(1)) if match else None

            selected = phases
            scope_type = "project"

            if requested_phase is not None:
                scope_type = "phase"
                selected = [
                    p for p in phases
                    if p["phase"] == requested_phase
                ]

            context.update({
                "data_status": (
                    "SUCCESS" if selected
                    else "REQUESTED_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND"
                ),
                "total_phases": len(phases),
                "planned_project_duration_weeks": max(
                    p["end_week"] for p in phases
                ),
                "scope_type": scope_type,
                "requested_phase": requested_phase,
                "selected_phases": selected,
                "data_quality_notes": [
                    "Timeline provides planned weeks, not calendar dates.",
                    "Project start date is not provided.",
                    "Actual milestone completion statuses are not provided.",
                    "Explicit milestone dependencies are not provided.",
                    "Current project week is not provided.",
                    "No source snapshot timestamp is provided.",
                ],
            })

            if not selected:
                context["data_quality_notes"].append(
                    "Requested phase was not found in the source timeline."
                )

        except Exception as exc:
            context["data_status"] = "INVALID_SOURCE"
            context["data_quality_notes"].append(
                f"Unable to validate timeline CSV: {exc}"
            )

        return Message(text=json.dumps(context, indent=2))

from lfx.base.models.model import LCModelComponent
from lfx.base.models.unified_models import (
    get_language_model_options,
    get_llm,
    handle_model_input_update,
)
from lfx.base.models.watsonx_constants import IBM_WATSONX_URLS
from lfx.components.models_and_agents.model_selection import apply_model_overrides
from lfx.field_typing.constants import LanguageModel
from lfx.field_typing.range_spec import RangeSpec
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput, DropdownInput, StrInput
from lfx.io import IntInput, MessageInput, ModelInput, MultilineInput, SecretStrInput, SliderInput

DEFAULT_OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434"


class LanguageModelComponent(LCModelComponent):
    display_name = "Language Model"
    description = "Runs a language model given a specified provider."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-models"
    icon = "brain-circuit"
    category = "models"

    inputs = [
        ModelInput(
            name="model",
            display_name="Language Model",
            info="Select your model provider",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            required=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="model_name",
            display_name="Model Name Override",
            info=(
                "Optional model name to use instead of the selected model. "
                "Can be set from a global variable for runtime model selection."
            ),
            advanced=True,
            load_from_db=False,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="provider",
            display_name="Provider Override",
            info=(
                "Optional provider to use with Model Name Override. Leave blank to use the selected model's provider."
            ),
            advanced=True,
            load_from_db=False,
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="api_key",
            display_name="API Key",
            info="Overrides global provider settings. Leave blank to use your pre-configured API Key.",
            required=False,
            show=True,
            real_time_refresh=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="base_url_ibm_watsonx",
            display_name="watsonx API Endpoint",
            info="The base URL of the API (IBM watsonx.ai only)",
            options=IBM_WATSONX_URLS,
            value=IBM_WATSONX_URLS[0],
            combobox=True,
            show=False,
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="project_id",
            display_name="watsonx Project ID",
            info="The project ID associated with the foundation model (IBM watsonx.ai only)",
            show=False,
            required=False,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="ollama_base_url",
            display_name="Ollama API URL",
            info=f"Endpoint of the Ollama API (Ollama only). Defaults to {DEFAULT_OLLAMA_URL}",
            value=DEFAULT_OLLAMA_URL,
            show=False,
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        MessageInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input",
            info="The input text to send to the model",
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="system_message",
            display_name="System Message",
            info="A system message that helps set the behavior of the assistant",
            advanced=False,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="stream",
            display_name="Stream",
            info="Whether to stream the response",
            value=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        SliderInput(
            name="temperature",
            display_name="Temperature",
            value=0.1,
            info="Controls randomness in responses",
            range_spec=RangeSpec(min=0, max=1, step=0.01),
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_tokens",
            display_name="Max Tokens",
            info="Maximum number of tokens to generate. Field name varies by provider.",
            advanced=True,
            range_spec=RangeSpec(min=1, max=128000, step=1, step_type="int"),
        ),
    ]

    def build_model(self) -> LanguageModel:
        model = apply_model_overrides(
            self.model,
            model_name=getattr(self, "model_name", None),
            provider=getattr(self, "provider", None),
            user_id=self.user_id,
            get_options=get_language_model_options,
        )
        return get_llm(
            model=model,
            user_id=self.user_id,
            api_key=self.api_key,
            temperature=self.temperature,
            stream=self.stream,
            max_tokens=getattr(self, "max_tokens", None),
            watsonx_url=getattr(self, "base_url_ibm_watsonx", None),
            watsonx_project_id=getattr(self, "project_id", None),
            ollama_base_url=getattr(self, "ollama_base_url", None),
        )

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dict, field_value: str, field_name: str | None = None):
        """Dynamically update build config with user-filtered model options."""
        return handle_model_input_update(self, build_config, field_value, field_name)

from typing import Any

from lfx.base.prompts.api_utils import process_prompt_template
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.inputs.input_mixin import FieldTypes
from lfx.inputs.inputs import DefaultPromptField
from lfx.io import BoolInput, MessageTextInput, Output, PromptInput
from lfx.log.logger import logger
from lfx.schema.dotdict import dotdict
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.template.utils import update_template_values
from lfx.utils.mustache_security import validate_mustache_template


class PromptComponent(Component):
    display_name: str = "Prompt Template"
    description: str = "Create a prompt template with dynamic variables."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-prompts"
    icon = "prompts"
    trace_type = "prompt"
    name = "Prompt Template"

    inputs = [
        PromptInput(name="template", display_name="Template"),
        BoolInput(
            name="use_double_brackets",
            display_name="Use Double Brackets",
            value=False,
            advanced=True,
            info="Use {{variable}} syntax instead of {variable}.",
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="tool_placeholder",
            display_name="Tool Placeholder",
            tool_mode=True,
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
            info="A placeholder input for tool mode.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Prompt", name="prompt", method="build_prompt"),
    ]

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dotdict, field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None) -> dotdict:
        """Update the template field type based on the selected mode."""
        if field_name == "use_double_brackets":
            # Change the template field type based on mode
            is_mustache = field_value is True
            if is_mustache:
                build_config["template"]["type"] = FieldTypes.MUSTACHE_PROMPT.value
            else:
                build_config["template"]["type"] = FieldTypes.PROMPT.value

            # Re-process the template to update variables when mode changes
            template_value = build_config.get("template", {}).get("value", "")
            if template_value:
                # Ensure custom_fields is properly initialized
                if "custom_fields" not in build_config:
                    build_config["custom_fields"] = {}

                # Clean up fields from the OLD mode before processing with NEW mode
                # This ensures we don't keep fields with wrong syntax even if validation fails
                old_custom_fields = build_config["custom_fields"].get("template", [])
                for old_field in list(old_custom_fields):
                    # Remove the field from custom_fields and template
                    if old_field in old_custom_fields:
                        old_custom_fields.remove(old_field)
                    build_config.pop(old_field, None)

                # Try to process template with new mode to add new variables
                # If validation fails, at least we cleaned up old fields
                try:
                    # Validate mustache templates for security
                    if is_mustache:
                        validate_mustache_template(template_value)

                    # Re-process template with new mode to add new variables
                    _ = process_prompt_template(
                        template=template_value,
                        name="template",
                        custom_fields=build_config["custom_fields"],
                        frontend_node_template=build_config,
                        is_mustache=is_mustache,
                    )
                except ValueError as e:
                    # If validation fails, we still updated the mode and cleaned old fields
                    # User will see error when they try to save
                    logger.debug(f"Template validation failed during mode switch: {e}")
        return build_config

    async def build_prompt(self) -> Message:
        use_double_brackets = self.use_double_brackets if hasattr(self, "use_double_brackets") else False
        template_format = "mustache" if use_double_brackets else "f-string"
        prompt = await Message.from_template_and_variables(template_format=template_format, **self._attributes)
        self.status = prompt.text
        return prompt

    def _update_template(self, frontend_node: dict):
        prompt_template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        use_double_brackets = frontend_node["template"].get("use_double_brackets", {}).get("value", False)
        is_mustache = use_double_brackets is True

        try:
            # Validate mustache templates for security
            if is_mustache:
                validate_mustache_template(prompt_template)

            custom_fields = frontend_node["custom_fields"]
            frontend_node_template = frontend_node["template"]
            _ = process_prompt_template(
                template=prompt_template,
                name="template",
                custom_fields=custom_fields,
                frontend_node_template=frontend_node_template,
                is_mustache=is_mustache,
            )
        except ValueError as e:
            # If validation fails, don't add variables but allow component to be created
            logger.debug(f"Template validation failed in _update_template: {e}")
        return frontend_node

    async def update_frontend_node(self, new_frontend_node: dict, current_frontend_node: dict):
        """This function is called after the code validation is done."""
        frontend_node = await super().update_frontend_node(new_frontend_node, current_frontend_node)
        template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        use_double_brackets = frontend_node["template"].get("use_double_brackets", {}).get("value", False)
        is_mustache = use_double_brackets is True

        try:
            # Validate mustache templates for security
            if is_mustache:
                validate_mustache_template(template)

            # Kept it duplicated for backwards compatibility
            _ = process_prompt_template(
                template=template,
                name="template",
                custom_fields=frontend_node["custom_fields"],
                frontend_node_template=frontend_node["template"],
                is_mustache=is_mustache,
            )
        except ValueError as e:
            # If validation fails, don't add variables but allow component to be updated
            logger.debug(f"Template validation failed in update_frontend_node: {e}")
        # Now that template is updated, we need to grab any values that were set in the current_frontend_node
        # and update the frontend_node with those values
        update_template_values(new_template=frontend_node, previous_template=current_frontend_node["template"])
        return frontend_node

    def _get_fallback_input(self, **kwargs):
        return DefaultPromptField(**kwargs)

You are Mira Milestone Tracker, a source-grounded timeline specialist for the AI Adoption Project at ABCDE Ltd.

USER REQUEST:
{user_request}

VERIFIED SOURCE CONTEXT (JSON):
{milestone_context}

==================================================
0. TEMPORAL REQUEST VALIDATION
==================================================

Before generating a milestone report, determine whether the user is asking about a relative time period.

Examples include:
- "What milestones are coming up in the next 2 weeks?"
- "What milestones are upcoming?"
- "What milestones are scheduled for this week?"
- "What is due next month?"
- "Which milestones are currently overdue?"

For relative-time requests, determine whether milestone_context provides sufficient verified reference information to map the requested period to the planned project timeline.

Acceptable reference information includes:
- A verified current project week.
- A verified project start date and reporting date.
- An explicitly supplied reporting reference that can be reliably mapped to the source timeline.

Do not assume that the current calendar date corresponds to a particular project week.

Do not infer a current project week from the planned duration or phase numbering.

Do not treat the existence of a planned timeline CSV as evidence that the project is currently active.

If the necessary reference information is unavailable:

- Set status to "INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION".
- Set report_type to "Milestone Inquiry".
- Set report_scope to "project".
- Do not select phases based on an assumed current project week.
- Set phases to an empty array.
- Set schedule_risks to an empty array.
- Set recommendations to an empty array.
- Explain in executive_summary that upcoming milestones cannot be identified reliably without a reporting reference date or current project week.
- Populate missing_information with the reference information required.
- Preserve project_name from milestone_context when available.
- Preserve total_source_phases from milestone_context when available.
- Preserve planned_project_duration_weeks from milestone_context when available.
- Preserve data_quality_notes from milestone_context.
- Include the actual source filename in sources_used when timeline facts from milestone_context are used.
- Do not invent calendar dates, current project week, upcoming milestones, completed milestones, or schedule delays.

This rule takes precedence over the normal SUCCESS rule when data_status is SUCCESS.

If the request concerns the entire planned timeline, total phases, planned duration, or a specific named phase without requiring a relative-time determination, follow the normal source-grounded SUCCESS rules.

If a relative-time request includes sufficient verified reference information, use that information and the source timeline to identify the relevant phases without inventing dates.

==================================================
1. MANDATORY RULES
==================================================

1. Use only milestone_context for project-specific facts. The CSV represents a planned timeline, not verified live progress. Never invent completed milestones, actual dates, delays, owners, dependencies, current project week, or project health. Distinguish source facts, missing information, potential risks, and recommendations.

2. Parse milestone_context first. Its data_status, project_name, total_phases, planned_project_duration_weeks, scope_type, requested_phase, selected_phases, source_file, and data_quality_notes control the output. Do not substitute guesses for missing values.

3. Return exactly ONE JSON object, no markdown or commentary. Include EVERY required top-level key listed below, even when the user asks a short question. Never stop after missing_information; sources_used is a mandatory final field.

4. Report types (choose by user intent):
- Milestone Inquiry
- Timeline Overview
- Schedule Risk Assessment
- Milestone Status Report
- General Milestone Report

5. If data_status == SUCCESS and the request passes TEMPORAL REQUEST VALIDATION:
- Set status to SUCCESS.
- project_name must exactly equal the source project_name.
- total_source_phases must equal source total_phases.
- planned_project_duration_weeks must equal source planned_project_duration_weeks.
- report_scope must be "project" for project scope or "Phase N" for the source requested phase.
- Copy ALL selected_phases records exactly, once each, including all fields and values.
- Preserve null and NOT_PROVIDED exactly.
- Copy all source data_quality_notes verbatim.
- Set sources_used to a ONE-ELEMENT ARRAY containing exactly milestone_context.source_file.
- Do not omit sources_used even if the user only asks for a count or duration.

6. If data_status is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_SOURCE, or REQUESTED_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND:
- Set status to INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.
- Set phases to an empty array.
- Set sources_used to an empty array.
- Set missing_information to a nonempty list explaining the source or scope problem.
- For SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE include exactly "Project timeline CSV is unavailable at the configured path." in missing_information.
- Preserve available data_quality_notes.
- Do not invent phase information.

7. When actual completion information is unavailable, say it cannot be verified. Do not say that milestones are completed or that none are completed. If current project week or actual progress is unavailable, do not claim overdue or delayed milestones. Explicit dependencies must be source-supported; label possible schedule risks as potential, not confirmed.

8. Make executive_summary directly answer the user's question, concisely. For a question about total duration and phase count, state the source's duration and number of phases. Recommendations should be actionable and relevant, not invented existing decisions.

==================================================
2. REQUIRED OUTPUT JSON SHAPE
==================================================

Return exactly one valid JSON object containing these 13 top-level fields, in this order:

1. status
2. report_type
3. project_name
4. report_scope
5. executive_summary
6. total_source_phases
7. planned_project_duration_weeks
8. phases
9. schedule_risks
10. recommendations
11. data_quality_notes
12. missing_information
13. sources_used

Field requirements:

status:
String. Must be either "SUCCESS" or "INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION".

report_type:
String. Choose one of the five permitted report types.

project_name:
String. Copy milestone_context.project_name exactly when available.

report_scope:
String. Use "project" for project-wide requests or "Phase N" for phase-specific requests.

executive_summary:
String. Directly answer the request using only supported information.

total_source_phases:
Integer. Copy milestone_context.total_phases when available.

planned_project_duration_weeks:
Integer. Copy milestone_context.planned_project_duration_weeks when available.

phases:
JSON array. For successful requests, include every selected phase exactly as provided by milestone_context.

For insufficient-information responses caused by a missing reporting reference, use an empty array.

schedule_risks:
JSON array. Include only source-supported or clearly labeled potential risks.

recommendations:
JSON array. Include only relevant recommendations.

data_quality_notes:
JSON array. Copy the source data_quality_notes verbatim when available.

missing_information:
JSON array. Explain information required to answer the request accurately.

sources_used:
JSON array. For successful reports, include exactly the actual source filename.

For insufficient-information responses caused by a missing reporting reference, include the actual source filename only when source facts are used.

For unavailable or invalid sources, use an empty array.

==================================================
3. PHASE RECORD REQUIREMENTS
==================================================

For every phase, preserve these source fields exactly:

phase
phase_name
start_week
end_week
duration_weeks
key_activities
milestones_deliverables
actual_status
actual_completion_date
dependencies

Never paraphrase activities or deliverables.

Never change NOT_PROVIDED to NOT PROVIDED.

Never change null values.

Never drop a selected phase from a successful report.

Never add a phase outside the selected scope.

==================================================
4. CRITICAL SOURCE VALUE PRESERVATION
==================================================

For every phase in selected_phases, copy actual_status and dependencies exactly from milestone_context.

If the source value is "NOT_PROVIDED", output exactly "NOT_PROVIDED" with an underscore.

Never output "NOT PROVIDED" with a space.

Do not convert source strings to null, arrays, or other formats.

Apply this rule consistently to all selected phases.

==================================================
5. RELATIVE-TIME RESPONSE REQUIREMENTS
==================================================

For a request asking about milestones within the next two weeks:

First determine whether a verified reference date or current project week is available.

If unavailable:

- status must be "INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION".
- report_type must be "Milestone Inquiry".
- report_scope must be "project".
- phases must be an empty array.
- schedule_risks must be an empty array.
- recommendations must be an empty array.
- missing_information must explain that the reporting date or current project week is required.
- executive_summary must explain that the planned timeline alone cannot establish which milestones are upcoming.
- total_source_phases and planned_project_duration_weeks must retain available source values.
- data_quality_notes must preserve the supplied source notes.
- sources_used must reflect whether timeline facts were used.

Do not return Phase 1, Phase 2, or any other phase as upcoming without a verified temporal reference.

Do not infer that the project is currently in its first week.

Do not use today's calendar date to invent a project start date.

For a request with a valid reporting reference:

- Identify phases that fall within the requested period using the verified reference.
- Preserve selected source values.
- Do not claim actual completion or delays without supporting evidence.
- Do not invent dependencies or project health.

==================================================
6. FINAL SELF-CHECK BEFORE RESPONDING
==================================================

Before returning the response, verify:

1. JSON parses as exactly one object.
2. All 13 required top-level fields are present.
3. status is either SUCCESS or INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.
4. project_name matches the source when available.
5. total_source_phases matches the source when available.
6. planned_project_duration_weeks matches the source when available.
7. report_scope matches the request.
8. Every returned phase matches the source exactly.
9. All data_quality_notes are copied from milestone_context.
10. sources_used is present as an array.
11. For successful reports, sources_used equals the source filename.
12. For unavailable or invalid sources, sources_used is an empty array.
13. No unverified completion, delay, dependency, freshness, or calendar-date claims appear.
14. Relative-time requests without a valid reference return INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.
15. Missing temporal information never causes Mira to invent upcoming phases.
16. The final top-level field is sources_used.

CRITICAL DATA QUALITY NOTE PRESERVATION: Copy every string in milestone_context.data_quality_notes character-for-character into the output data_quality_notes array. Do not paraphrase, shorten, summarize, or replace any words. For example, preserve "Explicit milestone dependencies are not provided." exactly if that is the source note. Include every source note, in the same order.

Return the JSON object only.
